_about: 隔空指点 — point the 剑诀 at the screen, a test game in the 游戏厅 (Hanli 2026-10-21: 「剑诀目前是手指朝上, 如果手指指向屏幕, 是否可行. 一个用户隔空双指点屏幕的demo视频, 也许能引起兴趣」; 「好，先做试玩」). The player holds 剑诀 (jieyin.json `seals.jian`, the one rule) with the two fingers at the camera: a 准星 follows the fingertips (`aim`), a quick jab toward the camera (`poke`) throws a 火蛋 where the 准星 stood. Beasts drift across the 山道 (`spawn`); hits in `seconds` give the stars. The seal is judged by joint angles on the 3D world points (games/jieyin/judge3d.js, `judge3d`), so it counts pointing up and pointing at the lens. No camera → one line, nothing else. 游戏厅 only; not in the story. doc/games.md § 隔空指点.
_judge3d: judge3d.js: a finger is straight when it bends (middle + end joints) less than `extDeg` in all, folded when more than `curlDeg`; `near` / `far` in palm-widths (index root → little-finger root). Synthetic 剑诀 (pose.js), up or at the lens, depth squashed to 0.3: index/middle 0–12°, ring/little 132–157°, tips 0.51 palm apart; a V (fingers spread) 0.95. A held 剑诀 is judged `loose` (15%) wider.
_aim: aim.js: the 准星 is the midpoint of `from` in the camera's picture, mirrored (move right, it goes right), the inner `box` of the picture [x0, y0, x1, y1] stretched to the whole field (no reaching for the frame's edge), then held still inside `dead` (field units) and eased over `tauMs` beyond it.
_poke: poke.js: the hand's size in the picture (wrist → index root + wrist → little-finger root + index root → little-finger root) grows by `grow` over its smallest in the last `windowMs` = a jab at the camera; the shot goes where the 准星 stood at that smallest (the tips move while the hand jabs). Not a jab: the 准星 moved more than `maxShift` across that window (a sweep or a lost track), 剑诀 not held, or within `coolMs` of the last; after a shot the size starts over from where it is. Needs the camera read at ≥ `fps` (a 220 ms jab is 6 frames at 30, 3 at 15).
_hint: Over jieyin.json's `hint` for this game only: a hand pointed at the lens is foreshortened in the picture (wrist → middle root ~¼ of the same hand held up), so the hand hint's 'too far' comes at a quarter of 结印's.

title.en: Point in the air · The mountain road

levels._spawn: core.js: a beast every `everyMs` (± `jitter`), from either side on one of `lanes` (field height), at a speed in `speed` (field widths a second), `foes` by weight; `r` its hit radius (field width). Seeded: 再来 deals a fresh one.

lead.zh: 野兽一只只从山道上横穿过去。剑诀对准镜头，两指指哪，准星就到哪——往前一点，火蛋出手。
lead.en: Beasts cross the mountain road one by one. Point the sword seal at the camera: the crosshair goes where the two fingers point — jab forward and the fire egg flies.
